subject: Delay with the bibliography
text:
I hope you are well and that your semester is going smoothly. I am writing to explain why I have not sent the annotated bibliography yet. I underestimated how much extra work the source summaries would require, and my draft is still incomplete. I want to make sure the citations are accurate before sharing something so rushed.

Could you give me until Thursday? I have already completed the outline and about half the entries, so I only need to finish the final annotations and proofread everything once. If Thursday does not work, I can send what I have by tonight and mark the missing sections clearly. Please tell me if that suits your schedule, or if you prefer a shorter preview.

Thank you for your patience, and I am sorry for any inconvenience.
